title: Articulus Plēnus
subtitle: Dēclīnātiō plēna articulī (ὁ ἡ τό) per omnēs cāsūs, et ūsūs syntacticī praecipuī nōn adhūc vīsī.
objectives: Dēclīnāre plēnē articulum (ὁ ἡ τό) per omnēs cāsūs, utrōque numerō, omnibus generibus
Recognōscere articulum sequī fōrmās dēclīnātiōnis prīmae (fēminīnum) et secundae (masculīnum/neutrum) iam discitās
Applicāre articulum ad phrāsēs substantīvāta (ὁ σοφός “vir sapiēns”, τὸ καλόν “id quod pulchrum est”)
Distinguere ūsum Graecum articulī cum nōminibus abstractīs/genericīs (ubi Latīnum nūllum habet)

content.intro: Ἀγάθων ὁ σοφὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν φιλεῖ. Notāvistī: ὁ σοφός — articulus + adiectīvum, sine nōmine explicitō, tamen sēnsum complētum habet: “ille sapiēns”. Gradus I dedit fōrmās nōminātīvās articulī (ὁ, ἡ, τό); nunc, cum dēclīnātiō prīma et secunda nōtae sint, articulus plēnē dēclīnārī potest.
content.explanation:
Ἀγάθων ὁ σοφὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν φιλεῖ. Μελίτη λέγει· “Τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν φιλεῖς, ὦ φίλε;” “Ναί,” λέγει Ἀγάθων, “καὶ αἱ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀρεταὶ καλαί εἰσιν.” (Agathōn sapiēns vēritātem amat. Melitē dīcit: “Pulchrum et bonum amās, amīce?” “Ita,” dīcit Agathōn, “et mulierum virtūtēs pulchrae sunt.”)

Notāvistīne ὁ σοφός (articulus + adiectīvum, sine nōmine, “ille sapiēns”) et τὸ καλόν, τὸ ἀγαθόν (nōtiōnēs abstractae cum articulō)? Articulus Graecus concordat semper in genere, numerō, et cāsū cum nōmine suō (sīcut adiectīvum), praecēdēns illud nōrmāliter. Fōrmae singulārēs nōminātīvae (ὁ, ἡ, τό) et plūrālēs (οἱ, αἱ, τά) sunt anōmalae (nōn sequuntur exāctē patrōnum nōminum, ex ratiōnibus historicīs — antīquitus erant prōnōmina dēmōnstrātīva); omnēs cēterae fōrmae sequuntur patrōnum dēclīnātiōnis prīmae/secundae plēnē.

rules.heading: a) Articulus: Dēclīnātiō Plēna
rules.body:

Nōm.ὁἡτό
Gen.τοῦτῆςτοῦ

Nōtā: genetīvus plūrālis est τῶν in omnī genere — comparā cum -ῶν, dēsinentia commūnis genetīvī plūrālis quam iam nōvistī ex prīmā dēclīnātiōne.

rules.heading: b) Ūsus: Substantīvātiō
rules.body: Graecum frequenter adhibet articulum cum adiectīvō (sine nōmine explicitō) ad significandum “ille quī est...” vel “id quod est...”: ὁ σοφός “vir sapiēns” (litt. “ille sapiēns”), τὸ καλόν “pulchritūdō, id quod pulchrum est” (nōtiō abstracta, philosophīs cāra), οἱ πολλοί “plēbs, multitūdō” (litt. “illī multī”). Hoc phaenomenon (“substantīvātiō”) est extrēmē frequēns in prōsā philosophicā et rhētoricā Graecā.

rules.heading: c) Ūsus: Nōmina Abstracta et Generica
rules.body: Graecum adhibet articulum cum nōminibus abstractīs et genericīs ubi Anglicum/Lūsitānicum id nōn faciunt: ἡ ἀλήθεια “vēritās” (in genere, nōn “illa vēritās speciālis”), ὁ θάνατος “mors” (in genere). Nōn est error trānsferre haec sine articulō Latīnē/Anglicē (“vēritās”, nōn “illa vēritās”) — Graecum sōlum habet regulam propriam dē quandō articulus adhibendus sit, dīversam ā regulīs Anglicīs/Lūsitānicīs.

examples: ὁ σοφὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν φιλεῖ. — Sapiēns vēritātem amat. (nōtā ἀλήθειαν cum articulō, abstractum)
τῶν πολιτῶν οἱ σοφοί. — Ex cīvibus, sapientēs. (τῶν πολιτῶν gen. pl. partitīvum)
τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθόν. — Pulchrum et bonum. (substantīvātiō adiectīvōrum, nōtiōnēs philosophicae)
τοῖς θεοῖς θύομεν. — Diīs sacrificāmus. (datīvus plūrālis post verbum)
διὰ τὸν θάνατον. — Propter mortem. (accūsātīvus post praepositiōnem, cāsum vidēbis plēnius mox)
αἱ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀρεταί. — Virtūtēs mulierum. (genetīvus plūrālis, articulus concordāns cum γυναικῶν)

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere articulum sequī ūnam sōlam dēclīnātiōnem (ut sōlam secundam) in omnibus generibus.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī masculīnum/neutrum sequuntur patrōnum secundae dēclīnātiōnis, fēminīnum sequitur patrōnum prīmae dēclīnātiōnis.
commonMistakes.why: Articulus nōn est nōmen ipse ūnīus dēclīnātiōnis, sed sequitur duo patrōnōs dēclīnātiōnis simul, secundum genus.

commonMistakes.wrong: Omittere articulum cum nōminibus abstractīs Graecīs (ἀλήθεια, θάνατος), imitandō ūsum Anglicum/Lūsitānicum.
commonMistakes.right: Adhibēre articulum cum tālibus nōminibus in Graecō, sīcut ūsus grammaticus Graecus id requīrit.
commonMistakes.why: Discrīmen inter linguās in ūsū articulī cum abstractīs est frequēns fōns errōris apud incipientēs.

commonMistakes.wrong: Nōn recognōscere ὁ σοφός/τὸ καλόν ut phrāsēs substantīvātās, quaerendō nōmen absēns implicitum.
commonMistakes.right: Intellegere articulus + adiectīvum sine nōmine explicitō SIGNIFICAT “ille/id quī/quod est...” — cōnstrūctiō completa in sē ipsā.
commonMistakes.why: Substantīvātiō est ūsus idiōmaticus normālis, nōn ellīpsis dēfectīva quae nōmen requīrat.

exercises.title: Ὁ Σοφὸς τὴν Ἀλήθειαν Φιλεῖ
exercises.instructions: Lege, deinde responde secundum sensum, non verbum singulum.
exercises.passage: Ἀγάθων ὁ σοφὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν φιλεῖ. Μελίτη λέγει· “Τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν φιλεῖς, ὦ φίλε;” “Ναί,” λέγει Ἀγάθων, “καὶ αἱ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀρεταὶ καλαί εἰσιν.”

items.explanation: Ἀγάθων ὁ σοφὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν φιλεῖ.
“Τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθὸν φιλεῖς;”

items.prompt: Quid Agathōn dē virtūtibus mulierum dīcit?
items.explanation: “Αἱ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀρεταὶ καλαί εἰσιν.”

exercises.title: Quid Vērē Dīcitur? (Ex Sēnsū)
exercises.instructions: Relege sententiās suprā. Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit, ex sēnsū, nōn ex nōmine cāsūs.

items.statement: “Ὁ σοφός” refert ad Ἀγάθωνα ipsum, quamvīs nōmen eius nōn repetātur in illā phrasī.
items.explanation: Substantīvātiō: articulus + adiectīvum sōlus significat “ille sapiēns” — hīc, Ἀγάθων ipse.

items.statement: “Τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀγαθόν” sunt nōmina propria persōnārum in hōc dialogō.
items.explanation: Falsum: sunt adiectīva substantīvāta, referentia ad nōtiōnēs abstractās (pulchrum, bonum), nōn persōnae.

items.statement: Cum Ἀγάθων dīcit “ναί”, respondet affirmātīvē quaestiōnī Melitēs.
items.explanation: Ναί (“ita”) affirmat id quod Melitē modo rogāverat.

items.statement: “Αἱ τῶν γυναικῶν ἀρεταί” significat virtūtēs quās Ἀγάθων ipse habet.
items.explanation: Falsum: τῶν γυναικῶν (genetīvus) indicat cuius sunt virtūtēs — mulierum, nōn Ἀγάθωνος.

items.prompt: Quae est fōrma genetīvī singulāris masculīnī/neutrī articulī?
items.explanation: Τοῦ servit ambōbus generibus masculīnō et neutrō in genetīvō singulārī.
Articulus + adiectīvum masculīnum significat “ille quī est [adiectīvum]”.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus plūrālis articulī, in quōvīs genere?
options: variat: τῶν masc., τάων fem., τῶν neut.
items.explanation: Τῶν servit omnibus tribus generibus in genetīvō plūrālī.

items.prompt: Cūr Graecum scrībit ἡ ἀλήθεια (cum articulō) prō “vēritās” generālī, ubi Anglicum nūllum articulum adhibet?
options: Graecum habet regulam propriam: nōmina abstracta/generica plērumque accipiunt articulum
items.explanation: Rēgula ūsūs Graeca dīversa est ab Anglicā/Lūsitānicā circa nōmina abstracta.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est accūsātīvus singulāris fēminīnus articulī?
items.explanation: Τήν est accūsātīvus singulāris fēminīnus.

exercises.title: Complē Articulum Rēctum (Dēclīnātum)
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā articulī, in cāsū indicātō.

items.explanation: Genetīvus singulāris masculīnus: τοῦ.
Datīvus singulāris fēminīnus: τῇ.
Accūsātīvus plūrālis neutrī = nōminātīvus: τά.
Genetīvus plūrālis, omne genere: τῶν.
Accūsātīvus plūrālis masculīnus: τούς.

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Articulus fēminīnus sequitur patrōnum dēsinentiārum prīmae dēclīnātiōnis (τιμή-typus).
items.explanation: Corrēctum: ἡ, τῆς, τῇ, τήν // αἱ, τῶν, ταῖς, τάς concordant cum patrōnō prīmae dēclīnātiōnis.

items.statement: Genetīvus singulāris articulī differt inter masculīnum et neutrum.
items.explanation: Falsum: ambō sunt τοῦ, identicī.

items.statement: Graecum semper omittit articulum cum nōminibus abstractīs, sīcut Anglicum.
items.explanation: Falsum: Graecum frequenter adhibet articulum cum abstractīs (ἡ ἀλήθεια), contrā ūsum Anglicum.

items.statement: Ὁ σοφός est exemplum substantīvātiōnis: articulus + adiectīvum sine nōmine explicitō.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: significat “ille sapiēns”, cōnstrūctiō idiōmatica frequēns.

summary: Articulus plēnus concordat in genere/numerō/cāsū cum nōmine suō: masc./neut. sequuntur dēclīnātiōnem secundam, fem. dēclīnātiōnem prīmam.
Fōrmae nōminātīvae (ὁ ἡ τό / οἱ αἱ τά) sunt anōmalae historicē; cēterae fōrmae sequuntur patrōnum nōminum plēnē.
Genetīvus plūrālis articulī est τῶν in omnī genere.
Articulus + adiectīvum (sine nōmine) fōrmat phrasim substantīvātam: ὁ σοφός “vir sapiēns”, τὸ καλόν “pulchritūdō”.
Graecum adhibet articulum cum nōminibus abstractīs/genericīs (ἡ ἀλήθεια) ubi linguae modernae saepe nōn adhibent.
